text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stands are roaring with excitement before the start of the Classic G1 Oka Sho. Many in the audience are cheering for Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in the waiting room, Mejiro Dober shrinks back under the cheers from the crowd. However, recalling her experience at the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies gives her confidence, and she makes her way to the gates.
